updates.title: CVE-2026-49179: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute code remotely over the network. This is a critical vulnerability affecting core identity infrastructure that admins should patch immediately.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as MFA Second Factor
updates.summary: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO can now serve as a standalone second factor for multifactor authentication, eliminating the need for users to register a separate passkey for step-up authentication and sign-in frequency checks. This simplifies MFA enrollment while maintaining strong, phishing-resistant authentication.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Role Groups UI Enhancements
updates.summary: The Role Groups page in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal now includes the ability to search and look up permissions by roles and memberships, streamlining role administration and governance tasks. This improves visibility and management efficiency for compliance and security admins.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention Support for FTP and SFTP
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing organizations to monitor and prevent sensitive data exfiltration via file transfer protocols from managed endpoints. This closes a data protection gap for organizations relying on legacy file transfer methods.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Count of Labeled Documents Condition
updates.summary: A new DLP condition for Exchange Online enables rules to trigger based on the count of sensitivity-labeled attachments in an email, helping detect bulk exfiltration of sensitive documents across multiple files. This addresses high-volume data leakage scenarios that individual file-level rules might miss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be consolidated by user identity when multiple rules match the same incident, reducing alert noise and streamlining investigation workflows. This helps security teams focus on unique violations rather than duplicate alerts from overlapping policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Admins can now create and reuse centralized lists of keywords, domains, and email addresses across multiple DLP rules, reducing duplication and simplifying policy maintenance at scale. This improvement streamlines policy creation and reduces configuration errors.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – In-Product Diagnostics
updates.summary: eDiscovery now includes built-in self-service diagnostics to identify common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. This reduces reliance on support and helps admins quickly troubleshoot and resolve typical eDiscovery challenges.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold Reports
updates.summary: Out-of-the-box reports provide aggregated visibility into all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases, with filtering and export capabilities for further analysis. This helps compliance teams monitor and audit hold management across cases.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – AI-Powered Policy Sync Investigation
updates.summary: An AI-powered capability provides visibility into Endpoint DLP policy deployment health across devices, proactively identifying sync failures and their root causes with recommended remediation steps. This helps admins quickly diagnose and resolve policy enforcement issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Endpoint DLP Policy Sync Status Reporting SLA Reduction
updates.summary: The Endpoint DLP policy sync status update latency on the Purview UI is being reduced from 2 hours to 30 minutes, providing admins with faster visibility into policy deployment progress across managed devices. This improvement enables quicker troubleshooting and validation of policy rollouts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management will support hard deletion of OneDrive and SharePoint content through secure priority cleanup workflows, allowing compliance admins to permanently remove content after retention periods while maintaining safeguards against accidental data loss. This enables stricter data retention enforcement when required.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Network Data Security with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access enables network-layer inspection and enforcement of DLP policies on text and AI interactions, preventing sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications including generative AI platforms. This extends DLP protection beyond traditional endpoints to cloud and SaaS interactions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now consolidates the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view, manage, and preview both classic and AI-triaged alerts from one location. This improves workflow efficiency for insider risk investigation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded User Profile Signals
updates.summary: Insider Risk alerts now include enriched user profile details from Microsoft Entra, such as office location, employee type, department, and last working date, providing investigators with additional context for risk assessment. This enables more informed decision-making during alert triage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Investigators can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases in Insider Risk Management, with system-generated notes automatically logged when status, assignment, or escalation changes. This improves documentation and audit trails for insider risk investigations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in SharePoint Server allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. Organizations running on-premises SharePoint should apply patches promptly.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint Server allows an authorized attacker to tamper with content over a network. This vulnerability can result in unauthorized modification of SharePoint data.
